data.label: Viewer-relative observation
data.description: The actual model input: 13,708 encoded observation values for the acting seat. Board planes, public context, cargo descriptors and legal-action lookup features are derived from this same observation.

data.label: Board feature planes: 45 × 49 × 1,390

data.label: Global context: 578 features
data.description: HexContext gathers seat-relative public counters, mission progress, pieces, hands/posteriors, resource covariance and fixed global features. Each encoder learns its own 578→128 context MLP.

data.label: Legal action IDs: variable L
data.description: The second actual model input is a list of L ordered legal action IDs. 512 is the compiled serving padding floor, not the action-space size or a fixed number of choices. Padding uses ID −1. The complete action vocabulary contains 82,819 IDs.

data.label: Actor stem: 1,390→96
data.description: A learned 1×1 convolution compresses the feature channels independently at every canvas location. Selected channel rows also have entity-local fixed affine offsets from the refinement trial. The original weights still train; present purity is not assumed.
data.refinement_formula: Selected entity locations use W[channel]+weight_offset and b[channel]+bias_offset; other locations use W,b.

metadata.description: Detailed descriptive schematic of an exact latest.pt snapshot. Nodes own disjoint parameter sets; counts sum to the complete checkpoint model.

receptive_field.global_readout: Spatial mean and maximum cover the full canvas; local action descriptors gather explicit entity positions.

important_details: Actor and independent value network have separate learned CNN encoders and separate context MLP weights. They do not share a single convolutional residual stream.
Each encoder has a 1×1 stem and 16 dense-channel 3×3 convolutions arranged in 8 residual blocks. Every spatial map remains 45×49×96.
Convolutional identity skips are present. The added 256→256→256 MLP retains its depth and has no residual bypass.
There is no intermediate spatial downsampling or spatial max-pooling layer in the convolution stack. Global mean and global maximum pooling ARE present in the actual global readout.
The action head scores only supplied legal actions, with global family weighting; it is not a dense 82,819-way classifier.
The action policy and the three-class outcome distributions are different outputs.
Early-win bonus affects policy returns; critic labels remain −1/0/+1. Timeouts are terminal draws.
Configured dropout 0.1/0.5 remains in modules but is disabled during current PPG learning and inference.
Foundation fields critic_objective=terminal-mse and critic_encoder_gradients=True do not replace PPG’s actual categorical NLL and phase-specific gradient isolation.
Fixed feature-refinement offsets are buffers. The selected original stem weights remain trainable; initial clean-detector meanings are not proof of present monosemanticity.

The independent encoder’s entity/ship adapters are stored but disconnected from value outputs and current losses. Their 5,664 parameters are included in the total. This is a module-level connectivity statement; individual embedding-row usage was not audited.

precision.live_cuda_inference: Compiled BF16 autocast; selected reductions/output probabilities use FP32.
precision.cpu_shape_verification: FP32, eager, one actual ordinary game observation; no GPU or training interruption.

training.gradients: Policy phase: actor policy loss and separate critic outcome loss. Auxiliary phase: actor outcome loss plus KL to immutable post-policy policy.

metadata.format_notes: Version/name/nodes/edges follow the supplied example. Each node adds descriptions, shapes, parameter ownership and observed shape evidence. Additional operation kinds name exact operations absent from that small example; this is a schematic, not an executable model format.
